Stem seems to have lost the word "লম্ব": as written ("ভূমিতলের উপর অবস্থিত যেকোনো সরলরেখা") it describes ভূ-রেখা, same as ch10.003, but the key says উর্ধ্বরেখা. Book p0202: ভূ-রেখা lies in the ground plane. Fix the stem to "ভূমিতলের উপর লম্ব যেকোনো সরলরেখা".

Doubtful key: the stem says "আনুষ্ঠানিকভাবে" and 10 April is also an option. The source (BGS Test(Ans) p0198) says the formal Proclamation (স্বাধীনতার ঘোষণা আদেশ) was issued on 10 April 1971, while 26 March is the declaration/independence day. Either key 10 April or drop "আনুষ্ঠানিকভাবে" from the stem.
